verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules, such as triggers or webhooks that fire actions, are a plausible capability for an AI inference cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only OpenAI-compatible inference, service tiers, fail_fast, dedicated deployments and GPU clusters. Autoscaling is platform-managed resource scaling, not user-defined event rules, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
